_comment: A film the keep rule drops twice over: poster_path is null, so there is no
art to show it with, and release_date is nineteen years old with no votes,
so neither half of the 'voted or recent' clause holds.
The tests flip adult to true on a copy of this to check the adult half of
the rule separately, because TMDB filters adult titles out of the public id
export itself (measured: zero adult lines in the 2026-09-16 movie export)
and the only way one reaches the keep rule is an id already in the catalog.
Same field names and provenance as tmdb-movie-normal.json.
